name: DICK'S Sporting Goods Pittsburgh Marathon
typicalWeather: Early-May starts of about 44–61 °F in recent years (third-party guide)
summary: The Pittsburgh Marathon has been held since 1985, usually on the first Sunday in May. The hilly course crosses Pittsburgh's three rivers and passes through many neighbourhoods. A city notice says the marathon course forms a loop around the city.
courseHighlights: Crosses all three rivers of Pittsburgh
Runs through the city centre and many neighbourhoods
A main climb around mile 12 over the Birmingham Bridge and up Forbes Avenue (third-party guide)
Downtown start and finish in the city centre or North Shore area

paceStrategy.summary: The early miles by the rivers are easy, and the biggest climb comes around mile 12, with more rises after that. Start slowly and run the hills by effort.

segments.terrain: Near river level on the North Shore, West End and South Side (third-party guide)
segments.advice: Hold goal pace or a little slower; save energy for later.

segments.terrain: Birmingham Bridge and the climb up Forbes Avenue into Oakland and Shadyside
segments.advice: Run by effort and take the climb in short, steady steps.

segments.terrain: Rolling roads through the east side of the city, with some descents
segments.advice: Stay steady and use the downhills without braking too hard.

segments.terrain: Descent towards Lawrenceville and back downtown
segments.advice: Hold form and push over the final miles.

fuelingNotes: The official site is hard to read without JavaScript, so check the race guide for aid-station positions. Take a gel before the Birmingham Bridge climb, around mile 11.
tips: Check the current course map: Wikipedia notes the start and finish have moved many times
Include hill repeats in training; the route uses the city's hilly terrain
The marathon crosses the rivers over several bridges, so expect wind on the bridges
Many downtown roads close from early morning until the afternoon, so plan transport ahead

faq.question: Is the Pittsburgh Marathon hilly?
faq.answer: Yes. Wikipedia calls the course hilly, and a third-party guide describes a main climb around mile 12. No official elevation figure was found, so no number is given here.

faq.question: When is the Pittsburgh Marathon held?
faq.answer: It is usually held on the first Sunday in May.

faq.question: Which rivers does the Pittsburgh Marathon cross?
faq.answer: The course crosses all three of Pittsburgh's main rivers.
